body:
## Summary
- Add a simple install request issue template that starts with `@sepo-agent /install` and leaves space for a requester to paste a public target repo URL.
- Link README and install docs to the install request issue template.
- Update the install prompt/workflow so successful issue-backed install runs mention the source request in the target PR body and close the source issue after posting the agent response.

## Verification
- `npm --prefix .agent run build`
- `node --test .agent/dist/__tests__/envelope.test.js .agent/dist/__tests__/install-target.test.js .agent/dist/__tests__/triage.test.js`
- `git diff --check`

Stacked on #285.

See [`README.md`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/f46f9b53e31e4aaa76f0f2b26930ab719b4a914b/README.md#L25) and [`install-existing-repository.md`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/f46f9b53e31e4aaa76f0f2b26930ab719b4a914b/.agent/docs/deployment/install-existing-repository.md#L45-L47). |
| communication | Write audience-first documentation | pass | 7/7 | The install guide leads with the user action: open the template or mention `/install`, then explains target resolution and blocked outcomes. |
| coding_workflow | Prefer permissive command route parsing | pass | 7/7 | The template uses only `@sepo-agent /install` plus a blank target URL area, while docs preserve slug/URL/natural-language target resolution. |
| coding_workflow | Make user-facing automation idempotent | pass | 7/7 | The close step checks for the published marker and skips already-closed issues before calling `gh issue close`. |
| communication | Keep status comments compact | pass | 6/6 | The close comment is concise: “Installation PR is ready: <url>” or a short fallback. |
| coding_workflow | Minimal defaults, native escape hatches | pass | 8/8 | The PR adds a minimal issue-template entry point and does not add new install policy/configuration surfaces. |
| coding_workflow | Reuse existing code | partial | 4/8 | The PR adds nontrivial workflow shell to parse the marker, extract a PR URL, check issue state, and close the issue directly in `agent-router.yml` instead of moving that behavior into a typed `.agent/src` CLI/helper. |
| coding_workflow | Prefer explicit structured inputs | partial | 3/7 | The workflow contract depends on a hidden markdown marker and regex URL extraction from the agent response rather than a typed/validated status output. See [`agent-install.md`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/f46f9b53e31e4aaa76f0f2b26930ab719b4a914b/.github/prompts/agent-install.md#L100-L105) and [`agent-router.yml`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/f46f9b53e31e4aaa76f0f2b26930ab719b4a914b/.github/workflows/agent-router.yml#L715-L728). |

## Notes

- The user-facing shape is good: the template is simple, docs are updated, and the source issue closes only after a successful published/reused install PR response.
- The main rubric gap is implementation placement/contract quality: parsing agent markdown and closing issues in inline workflow shell is less reusable and less structured than this repo’s usual typed helper/CLI pattern.

## Findings

- **WARNING:** The completion path should move out of inline workflow shell into a typed helper or CLI. This would better satisfy `reuse-existing-code` and make the marker/status parsing, PR URL extraction, issue-state check, and close behavior testable outside broad envelope regex assertions.
- **WARNING:** The published-status contract is encoded in response markdown. Prefer a structured, validated output or a small parser helper with focused regression coverage so malformed or accidental marker text cannot silently drive issue closure.

## Final Rubric Verdict

PARTIAL

## AI Review Synthesis

<!-- sepo-agent-review-synthesis -->
<!-- sepo-agent-review-synthesis-head: f46f9b53e31e4aaa76f0f2b26930ab719b4a914b -->

> Dual-agent review by **Claude** and **Codex**.
> Requested by @lolipopshock.

## Summary of PR/Issue
- PR #293 adds an install request issue template for `@sepo-agent /install`, then wires docs and prompt guidance so issue-backed install runs can link the source request.
- It also adds workflow cleanup that closes the source issue after the install response reports a published or reused target PR.
- The PR is stacked on #285, which is part of the broader #277/#284 `/install` PAT-backed fork PR implementation.
- The feature direction fits the parent plan, but the current branch is stale against its stacked base and has two workflow cleanup issues to address.

## Review
The PR needs rework before merge. One reviewer found the current stacked-base conflict, and that is confirmed by live GitHub state and a local merge-tree check; the other reviewer and rubrics review raised targeted workflow quality issues.

| Issue | Severity | Description |
| -- | -- | -- |
| PR no longer merges with current stacked base | BLOCKING | PR #293 still sits on `7f72353`, while its stacked base #285 is now at `6cbb5cea`; GitHub reports `mergeable:false` / `mergeable_state:dirty`, and local merge-tree shows conflicts. |
| Issue close cleanup can fail a successful install job | WARNING | The new source-issue close step lacks `continue-on-error`, so a transient `gh issue close` or permission failure can fail the install job after the target PR was already published. |
| Close comment can link the wrong install PR | WARNING | The prompt defines a structured `pr_url:` marker, but the workflow scans the full response and uses the first PR URL it finds, which can point to the wrong PR. |

## Progress
- Inspected the current PR conversation, PR #285, parent issue #277, child issue #284, all review artifacts, inline comments, and review threads.
- Existing inline comments and review threads were empty before synthesis.
- Posted one new inline comment on `.github/workflows/agent-router.yml:708` for the missing `continue-on-error`.
- The marker/regex URL concern is already covered in the existing rubrics discussion, so I did not duplicate it inline.
- No comments were minimized and no threads were resolved.

## Issue Details

<details>
<summary>PR no longer merges with current stacked base</summary>

**Cause:** PR #293 targets `agent/implement-issue-284/codex-26086793017`; that branch has advanced to `6cbb5cea`, while this PR still sits on `7f72353`. `git merge-tree --write-tree` reports conflicts in `.agent/docs/architecture/supported-workflows.md`, `.agent/docs/deployment/install-existing-repository.md`, and `.github/prompts/agent-install.md`.

**Candidate solutions:** Merge or rebase current #285 into #293, resolve the three conflicts, and preserve both #285’s install hardening and #293’s issue-template/source-close behavior.

**Comments:** Codex marked this blocking and current GitHub/local state supports it. Claude’s review was otherwise positive but did not account for the later base advancement.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Issue close cleanup can fail a successful install job</summary>

**Cause:** The new `Close completed install request issue` step runs after the response is posted but has no `continue-on-error: true`. That makes source-issue cleanup a workflow-failing operation even though the primary install result already succeeded.

**Candidate solutions:** Add `continue-on-error: true` to that step and keep the close behavior marker-gated.

**Comments:** Posted inline feedback at `.github/workflows/agent-router.yml:708`.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Close comment can link the wrong install PR</summary>

**Cause:** `.github/prompts/agent-install.md` asks for `<!-- sepo-install-status:published pr_url:<install-pr-url> -->`, but `.github/workflows/agent-router.yml` extracts the first PR URL anywhere in the response body.

**Candidate solutions:** Parse the PR URL from the marker line, or remove `pr_url` from the marker contract if the workflow should not depend on it. A small typed parser/helper with focused coverage would also address the rubrics concern about markdown parsing in workflow shell.

</details>

## Recommended Next Step
`FIX_PR`: the branch is dirty and the remaining workflow issues are concrete branch changes suitable for an automated fix-pr pass.

## Final Verdict
NEEDS_REWORK

## Action Items
- [ ] Update PR #293 onto current #285 head `6cbb5cea751ee2230f2f74bc80752f5d85b8f630` and resolve the merge conflicts.
- [ ] Add `continue-on-error: true` to the issue-close cleanup step.
- [ ] Extract the install PR URL from the structured published marker, or remove that marker field and adjust the contract/tests accordingly.
